caption: The drawing depicts a light beige horse with a stylized, slightly geometric body and a flowing mane. The horse is shown in profile, facing to the right, with its front right leg and back left leg raised in a prancing position. The horse is equipped with a saddle and several harnesses, all depicted in a medium brown color. The saddle has a rounded front edge and a flap on its side. The harnesses are simple and appear to wrap around the horse’s body, neck, and face, including a bit in its mouth. All four hooves are covered with brown bands. The horse stands against a flat, solid light blue background, with no other objects or details present.
title: Carousel Horse
